calculation.description: Ranks ten-day trend by recent realized volatility and confirms the trend with activity relative to its 40-day median volume. Higher values indicate stronger risk-adjusted trends with elevated participation.

validation.period: 2020-01-01 through 2030-12-11 data cutoff; valid signal observations begin after warmup
validation.regime_notes: Positive in 2027-2028, approximately flat in 2026, and negative in 2029-2030; interpret conservatively given 15-name cross-section and regime dependence. Strongest validated horizon is 5-10 trading days.
validation.method: Daily cross-sectional Spearman correlation between lagged factor values and forward close-to-close returns; observations require at least 8 valid instruments. ICIR is mean IC divided by sample IC standard deviation times sqrt(252).
